{

    {

    },
    {
      "login": "stringintech",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "prefers waiting for #30342 so API does not falsely suggest per-connection isolation"
    },
    {
      "login": "stickies-v",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Approach NACK; objects to exposing contextualized logging before #30342 is ready"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:3517090033",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Push forward #30342 before changing the logging API",
      "quote": "Maybe it would be preferable to push forward #30342 before this is done?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author argued this PR should take priority because it changes the API incompatibly while #30342 is backwards compatible",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3517459399"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:3517459399",
      "status_by_quote": "On the question of whether to push forward with this PR or #30342 first: I think this PR should have much higher priority than #30342."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3529907874",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Accepting per-connection handles on logging configuration functions suggests per-connection isolation while calling them still overrides settings globally across all connections",
      "quote": "keep the API consistent with what it's currently capable of",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "contested",
      "status_note": "stringintech reiterated preference to wait for #30342 after author's reply",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3530425864",
        "c:3533008173"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:3532613361",
      "status_by_quote": "My preference was to wait for #30342"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3532613361",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Whether delaying StartLogging() to context creation means context-free operations miss logs and whether it would need to move back if such operations log in the future",
      "quote": "This delay could mean logs won't be produced by context-free operations (like btck_script_pubkey_verify())",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that non-trivial operations producing logs should have an associated context object",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3533008173"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:3533008173",
      "status_by_quote": "I am a little surprised there would be any context-free operations except very basic ones that shouldn't log"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3532938522",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Exposing a new public interface before internal logging refactorings like #30342 proceed risks unexpected behavior and misses insights that internal changes could provide for interface design",
      "quote": "internal logging refactorings / changes (e.g. #30342, but also others) may surface roadblocks or ideas that inform us about a better interface design, so waiting a bit more seems helpful to me",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "contested",
      "status_note": "stickies-v pushed back with an Approach NACK, arguing interface and functional changes should happen atomically in #30342",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3533073827"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6014388996",
      "status_by_quote": "Approach NACK"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2606640746",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "If context does not own the logging connection, object lifetime management becomes brittle and destroying a logging connection could leave the associated context in an invalid state",
      "quote": "managing lifetimes becomes more brittle, i.e. users must ensure `logger` is kept alive for the duration of `context`",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "stickies-v agreed that context does not need to own the logging connection",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2606882104",
        "rc:2607212025",
        "rc:2607868168"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2607414440",
      "status_by_quote": "I agree then that there is no need for context to own the logging connection."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:3517090033",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "This is close to how I hoped to implement the logging capabilities",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3532938522",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "making the logging interface local instead of global",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "response to stickies-v's Approach NACK",
      "id": "c:6014388996"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Updated stickies-v's approach objection to contested following their Approach NACK in c:6014388996. Updated stringintech's objection to contested following pushback in c:3532613361. Added sedited's suggestion from c:3517090033 and stringintech's question from c:3532613361."
}
